style: Rules for the whole picture: the land carries the painted tile grid in the same perspective as the buildings, its lines parallel to the castle walls. Castle walls are straight cream stone walls along the grid, with square or round corner towers, never curved walls. Keep every important subject above the lowest sixth of the picture: the bottom middle shows only grass, ground or water. Not too busy, nothing too small, and the land is not bare. No people. No text, no letters, no numbers, no title, no watermark. Soft colours, not oversaturated, not a 3D render.

directions.title: A cannon firing
directions.scene: A closer view than the attached image, seen from high above at a three-quarter angle: one corner of a castle courtyard with two bronze cannons behind the cream battlements, orange-roofed houses along the walls, a river and a distant castle with a blue flag across green fields in the upper right.
directions.look: Take only the soft painterly 2D look, the colours and the light of the attached image, and make a new picture.
directions.cannons: Every cannon is a complete bronze barrel on one wooden carriage with two wheels, standing on the stone courtyard floor inside the walls, never on a wall, a wall walk, a tower, a roof or a house, its barrel raised to about 45 degrees. Exactly one cannon fires: the nearer of the two cannons fires over the wall at the distant castle, with a bright yellow flash and one big round white smoke cloud right at its muzzle and one dark cannonball a short way out beyond the muzzle on the line of its barrel, with a faint trail back to the muzzle. No other cannon fires, no other smoke, no other ball.

directions.title: The heavy gun fires
directions.scene: A closer view, seen from high above at a three-quarter angle: the open stone courtyard of a castle, and in its middle the heavy gun alone, a long iron gun in an iron-fitted wooden cradle on an open iron ring with a riveted side plate, raised to about 45 degrees over the wall toward a far castle with a blue flag beyond a river. Orange-roofed houses and a square keep along the walls.
directions.look: Take only the soft painterly 2D look, the colours and the light of the first attached image, and make a new picture. The second attached image shows only the design of one gun: paint that gun in the picture's own painterly style, at the size of a building in the courtyard.
directions.cannons: Exactly one cannon fires: the heavy gun fires over the wall at the far castle, with a bright yellow flash and one big round white smoke cloud right at its muzzle and one dark cannonball a short way out beyond the muzzle on the line of its barrel, with a faint trail back to the muzzle. No other cannon fires, no other smoke, no other ball.

directions.title: The mortar lobs a shell
directions.scene: Seen from high above at a three-quarter angle: a castle courtyard with the mortar in its middle, a fat iron pot mortar between riveted iron cheek plates on an open iron ring, its short barrel pointing steeply up. Its shell flies in a high steep arc over the wall toward a far castle with a blue flag across a river.
directions.look: Take only the soft painterly 2D look, the colours and the light of the first attached image, and make a new picture. The second attached image shows only the design of one gun: paint that gun in the picture's own painterly style, at the size of a building in the courtyard.
directions.cannons: Only the mortar fires: a yellow flash and one round white smoke cloud at its mouth, one dark shell high above on its steep arc with a faint trail. No other gun fires.

directions.title: Flak bursts a shot

High in the sky above the castle an incoming cannonball bursts into a small puff of grey smoke and iron fragments where the flak's two thin tracer lines meet it.
directions.look: Take only the soft painterly 2D look, the colours and the light of the first attached image, and make a new picture. The second attached image shows only the design of one gun: paint that gun in the picture's own painterly style, at the size of a building in the courtyard.
